root_cause_hypothesis:
Case assertions all PASSED: root data source <Name> read back = ConDemoRangeSource; both ranges landed in the ROOT AxQuerySimpleRootDataSource/<Ranges> (never the sibling entity-level <Ranges />), each carrying a non-empty <Value>; xppc compiled 0 errors twice; re-issuing add-query-range verbatim was a no-op (2738 -> 2738 bytes, reported "skipped (idempotent)"); remove-query-range by rangeName=SubjectPrefix left the IsActive range in place and did NOT collapse <Ranges>.

TOOL_DEFECT 1 (load-bearing for this case, RECURRENCE 2 of 4 runs): get_object_info(objectType="data-entity", options={include:"xml"}) served a STALE cached response after three intervening d365fo_file(action="modify") writes to the same file, and appended "Duplicate call - this exact get_object_info call was answered moments ago; the result above is identical. Use the data you already have instead of re-querying." The served body was the 2399-byte pre-write XML with an empty <Ranges />; disk was 2738 bytes with two ranges. The dedup cache is keyed on call shape and is not invalidated by writes through d365fo_file, and its wording actively instructs the agent to trust the stale copy. This case makes that exact read load-bearing (step 3 requires reading the data source <Name> back), so an agent that re-reads to verify its own write is told the write did not happen.

TOOL_DEFECT 2 (new): run_bp_check maps objectType "data-entity" to the xppbp element type "dataentity", which xppbp rejects - "The element type dataentity is invalid. Supported types are ... DataEntityView ...". The tool then advises "Use the kebab-case objectType the other tools take", which is circular: "data-entity" IS that token and is what was passed. The correct mapping is DataEntityView; passing targetElementType="DataEntityView" manually works. Net effect: no data entity can be BP-checked through the objects[] path.

bp_clean=0 is INHERENT to this case, not an implementation defect: 3 table warnings (BPTableWithRecIdIndexMissingReplacementKey, BPErrorDeveloperDocumentationNotDefined, BPErrorTableMissingFormRef - the case admits no AxForm, so FormRef is unreachable) plus 1 BP ERROR on the entity (DataEntitySecurityPrivilegeCheck, which fires on any public data entity with no AxSecurityPrivilege; the case admits none). Recorded as 4 for the dimension.

NOT observed: the joined-data-source half of the PR #927/#928 trap. No supported d365fo_file parameter adds an AxQuerySimpleEmbeddedDataSource to a data entity (the create contract exposes only primaryTable), so that half remains covered solely by tests/tools/queryRangeOps.test.ts, exactly as the case states.

Minor observations, non-blocking: (a) get_object_info(objectType="enum", name="NoYes") returns not-found for the base/system enum even though validate_code(references) resolves it and xppc compiles it; (b) table create reported "BP defaults: PrimaryIndex=SurrogateKey, ClusteredIndex=SurrogateKey" but wrote neither element to the XML - the message overstates what was applied; (c) data-entity create emits <Label>ConDemoRangeSourceEntity</Label> as raw text rather than a label id, which xppbp did not flag for AxDataEntityView but is still not a label reference.

Static gate detail: validate_code(syntax, xml-table) on ConDemoRangeSource reported 0 violations across 23 rule groups. validate_code(references, xml-any) on the entity XML reported "all 0 reference(s) verified" - it resolved NOTHING, because the resolver has no AxDataEntityView reader, so Table/DataField/Field refs inside <ViewMetadata> are not checked. Recorded as passed, but it is an empty pass.
suggested_fix_area: src/tools get_object_info response dedup/cache (invalidate on any d365fo_file write to the same object/file, and never emit the "Duplicate call ... use the data you already have" advisory for a read whose file size/mtime changed since the cached answer); run_bp_check element-type mapping (data-entity -> DataEntityView, plus fix the circular recovery hint); validate_code(references) AxDataEntityView reader so <ViewMetadata> Table/Field refs are actually checked
